resources.string: Check your connection and try again.
Sign in to see chain records
Only runs and shoes of a signed-in account are recorded on chain.
Run 200 m or more with GPS, draw a shoe or join a crew run, and it shows up here.
StepUp pays the gas and you never sign. Only confirmed records have a transaction — tap one to open it in the explorer.
One thing you actually did is at most one record. StepUp sends them every 2 minutes and pays the gas (GIWA Sepolia testnet).
Save a run of 200 m or more measured by GPS. Void, mock-location and held runs are left out. Up to 30 a day.
First run, 10 · 50 · 100 · 300 · 500 · 1,000 km in total, 3 · 7 · 14 · 30 · 100 days in a row. Each badge once.
Finish a course of 200 m or more along its route. Up to 30 a day.
Every free or premium draw mints that shoe into the StepUp vault on chain. You keep wearing it in the app.
Shoe stats — Shoes tab › My shoe
Upgrading or repairing a minted shoe updates its level and durability on chain, once with the latest values.
Wallet page — take out or put in
Moving SUP or shoes between the app and your wallet is a transaction too. Putting them back in is signed by your wallet.
Every draw (grade, draw number and seed hash — once the seed is revealed anyone can re-check the result), upgrade result, repair, stat point allocation and market trade.
Finished crew runs (distance, time, how many started together), flash runs that two or more started together, and joining a crew (once per crew).
One check-in on each day you open the app, and one daily step count (the final number, after the day ends).
Not recorded: runs under 200 m or without a route, earning or spending SUP in the app, putting shoes on, wear from running. Only a pseudonym is recorded — never your location, route, name or account.
Runs, shoes and crew activity — StepUp pays the gas
